validation:is-false.message: Customer Bill Error: One of (BILLING_NUMBER, FILTERS) needs to be present.

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json var validCombinations = [ "INVOICE_NUMBER; BILLING_ACCOUNT", "TRANSACTION_ID; INVOICE_TYPE; COMMENTS(optional)", "CONNECTION_NUMBER; START_TIME(optional); END_TIME(optional)", "CONNECTION_NUMBER; BILLING_ACCOUNT; START_TIME(optional); END_TIME(optional)", "CONNECTION_NUMBER; INVOICE_NUMBER; START_TIME(optional); END_TIME(optional)", "CUSTOMER_ID_TYPE; CUSTOMER_ID" ] var errorMsg = error.description ++ ": " ++ write(validCombinations, "application/java") --- { "status": "400", "code": "HTTP:BAD_REQUEST", "message": errorMsg, "messageServer": error.failingComponent default "CUSTOMER_BILL:INVALID_FILTERS", "cause": [ { "origin": "customer-papi-services-v2", "message": errorMsg } ] }
